text:
maya: Quick idea: introduce a 'staggered-mirror' onboarding flow for catalog migrations where the pinned model stays primary and we mirror a small percentage of traffic to the candidate for live A/B + golden-prompt checks. Goal: avoid surprise regressions for edge-case customers.

alex: How is this different from a normal canary?

maya: Two differences: (1) mirrored responses are not used for billing or user-visible outputs by default, (2) we require passing both synthetic golden prompts and a small live-sample check before we allow billing-switched traffic.

jorge: Proposed thresholds for initial pilot: acceptability delta >= -0.01 (no more than 1% drop), hallucination delta <= +0.7%, p95 latency delta <= +100ms, sustained error delta < 0.05%. Eval windows: 6 hours.

alex: Ramp plan? fixed or time-based?

jorge: Time-based mirror ramp: mirror only for first 72h at 5% of requests (mirror mode), then 48h at 20%, then 48h at 50%. After that, if gates pass for last two windows, flip production route. All durations configurable per catalog entry.

sasha: Billing: we'll add a "mirror=true" flag in router logs and exclude those from billing pipeline. For dedicated tenants, surface a console toggle to opt in to auto-flip. Small infra change ~2 dev days.

ops-bot: job queued: staggered-mirror-1700001111 - orchestration task created.

maya: Audit requirements: record initiator, reason, catalog entry id, customer opt-outs, and link to golden-prompt set version. Also we need a kill-switch API for SRE to immediately stop mirroring and revert any partial flips.

alex: Need an eval webhook to post golden-run results to the runbook and a pass/fail badge on the catalog page. I'll add the webhook endpoint.

jorge: I'll own dashboards and the golden prompt collection. Plan to keep golden sets versioned in KV and to sample 1% live traffic for match comparisons.

maya: Rollback triggers: (A) any gate breaches in two consecutive eval windows, (B) customer-visible error spike >0.1%, (C) manual SRE stop.

sasha: For billing clarity, during overlap we bill only the primary model. If downstream tasks require candidate outputs, mark them and charge separately. We'll document in README.

alex: Timeline: prototype in staging next week, pilot with two low-qps catalogs in two weeks. Dev estimates: infra 3 days, billing 2 days, dashboard 2 days.

maya: Owners: jorge (orchestration + dashboards), alex (router + webhook + kill-switch), sasha (billing + console opt-in), maya (spec + comms). I'll open the PR for the spec and include example config. :thumbsup:

jorge: Starting golden prompt curation now.

ops-bot: note: ensure console flag for dedicated tenants is off by default.

maya: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after staging smoke tests.
